meta.note: The term calendar the simulation runs over: term dates, closures, studio sessions, reviews, other-course deadlines, recurring social events and project phases. Values come from the owner's confirmed checklist (research/studio-culture-school-checklist.md, categories B, C, F) and the UBC calendar; every date marked inferred is a default the notes assumed [A] and the owner has not confirmed. The SCENARIO window's day picker reads it. Dates are ISO (YYYY-MM-DD), times 24 h local.
